Karnataka CM Shivakumar Addresses Cauvery Dispute and Housing Policy

Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has addressed two key issues: the Cauvery water dispute and a new housing policy. Regarding the Cauvery dispute, Shivakumar urged the Centre to simplify drought management guidelines and appealed to Prime Minister Modi for assistance. He also stated the state's position on water release is under watch, including a DMK petition in the Supreme Court. Separately, Shivakumar announced a policy to reclaim government-allotted plots if no house is built within five years, with beneficiaries to be reimbursed.
